name: phone
label: Phone Number
help: A US phone number. Fill in a phone number or an email address.

label: Your Reference ID
help: Optional. Echoed back in the result.

name: includeTcpaFlagged
label: Include TCPA-Flagged Phones
help: Off by default: phone numbers flagged as TCPA litigators are left out. Turn on only with a documented compliance basis. Flagged numbers carry "tcpa": true in the result.
